checks.title: Manual Core security and permission gate review
evidence: Threat boundary and connector permission review
No production write/merge approval laundering
Evidence for commands actually executed

checks.title: Manual requirement and acceptance traceability check
evidence: Source revision and approved requirement IDs
Acceptance scenario references and unresolved decisions
For imported documents: original/hash and conversion fidelity review, missing content, and full source-folder recovery plan; conversion is not approval
For external inputs: canonical resource/scope, capture revision/time/completeness, and actual host freshness evidence or explicit unavailable/unknown status

checks.title: Review scope, reuse and architecture fit
evidence: New/maintain/mixed scope per affected module and authoritative convention sources
Search scope, reusable public API paths, intended placement and new-code rationale
No dependency cycles, parallel common framework, unrelated refactor or unused code; report exceptions
Actual configured checks and manual boundary review, with limitations

checks.title: MVP and architecture impact fit at proportional depth
evidence: Source-linked context and applicable approved MVP/AC/NFR/ADR
Justified pattern/boundary choice and implementation/dependency plan
Actual decisions and verification; no unnecessary full-document gate

checks.title: Verify agent preferences in the actual host
evidence: Declared vs actual model/provider/effort and selected role namespace
Actual delegation/thread semantics or sequential-role limitation
No premium fallback, fake token meter or overwritten host configuration

checks.title: Review input/output ownership, source writes and spec-driven maintenance
evidence: Declared input revisions, output destinations and single canonical owner per group
Actual host connection/access and bounded write authorization; no credentials in project config
Reviewed artifact-impact coverage with docs/spec/UI diffs or explicit blocked dependencies

checks.title: Review proportional verification and selective docs
evidence: Applicable project methods and actual host limitations
Requirement-linked raw evidence, business assertions and owned cleanup
Static UNVERIFIED claims and affected-section source policy

checks.title: Review baseline continuity and scoped completion
evidence: Current vs handoff revisions, authority decisions and invalidated stale evidence
Artifact create/update/unchanged reasons, section diffs/proposals and pre-write revision recheck
Stable requirement/spec/code/test links with AC results and BLOCKED/NOT_RUN limits
Proposed feedback vs accepted scope; remaining work and distinct implementation/merge/release evidence

checks.title: Review scoped role/design authority and checkpoint recovery
evidence: No unapproved adapter infrastructure or design recipe
Canonical role/skill handoff with source/AC evidence
Reconciled baseline, side effects and measured or unknown usage

checks.title: Review actual user-journey evidence and blocked dependencies
evidence: Requirement surface and actual browser/device/CLI/API interaction at the tested revision
AC-linked visible/persisted outcomes, real vs mocked dependency scope and redacted attachments
Isolated actor/data/cleanup; required missing tools/account/environment explicitly BLOCKED or NOT_RUN

checks.title: Review grouped recovery and optional knowledge authority
evidence: Host/project-specific process and fixture ownership; bounded readiness and cleanup
Incremental actual evidence/draft updates and baseline-aware checkpoint/side-effect reconciliation
Source-linked optional knowledge; no copied domain or mandatory extra document tree

checks.title: Risk-selected engineering and document integrity review
evidence: Inspected revision, conventions, reuse and vertical slice with observable done condition
Relevant invariant/contract/compatibility risks mapped to actual scenarios and real/mocked evidence
Canonical document/ADR facts and proposals reconciled; render/device/export gaps explicitly NOT_RUN or BLOCKED
